title: 進路セミナーⅠ
subtitle: Career Planning Seminar I
educationalGoal: You have to open your life with your own power. In addition, economic power is an essential requirement in opening up your life. In this subject, you expect to learn practically, including self-analysis of the external lecturer about self-analysis and career industry analysis, career path manners and way of life in a competitive society, etc. are doing.
advice:
In addition to lectures focusing on texts that include practical content such as self-analysis, industry analysis, writing business documents, manners as a social worker, lecture meetings by external lecturers are also incorporated. Please note that lectures and lesson schedules etc can not necessarily coincide with the syllabus.
For the text, use the resume to be distributed and the course notes created by the university.
requiredKnowledge:
You need to be prepared to open up your own life.
Expect the ability to think seriously about the future.

activityGoals.body: Consider deeply about the relationship between your own life plan and your course.
Do the thought and action necessary for discovering your course.
Investigate knowledge, ability, nutrition, qualification etc necessary for setting your goal and achieving it.
Prepare and respond by yourself for the above③.
Explain your policy and goals regarding your own career such as admission and employment logically.
